description.narrative: Stöd till oberoende media i MENA regionen för att understödja alternativa röster och ansvarsutkrävande
Support to independent media organisations in the MENA region to promote alternative voices and accountability

The strategic ambition/goal of IMS regional strategy 2025-2028 is to:
"By the end of 2028, targeted independent media ecosystems in MENA will be strengthened and become more resilient, providing a diverse audience with access to reliable public interest content and fostering inclusive public debate that holds those in power to account."
The strategic ambition is supported by three strategic outcome areas that set the direction of IMS approach and programme priorities:
- Strategic outcome area 1: Public interest content, business viability. - Strategic outcome area 2: The safety and protection of journalists, content producers and media. - Strategic outcome area 3: Policy, laws, regulations and public interest infrastructure.
